summary: Well-structured TDD test suite with 26 unit tests, 4 workflow structure tests, and end-to-end act integration tests. Covers all core functions (parsing, bumping, writing, changelog generation) and major scenarios (feat/fix/breaking/none). Gaps: git fallback function is untested, run_act_tests.sh only covers 3 cases (feat/fix/breaking), no tests for empty commit logs or special character handling. Test design is clear with good fixture usage and independent temporary directories, but mixes frameworks (bats + bash script) and workflow.bats has awkward dependency on ci-fixture pre-existing in project root. Would reliably catch regressions in main code paths and CI pipeline, but might miss git integration edge cases.
